provenance.source: Project-owned PC CombatV2 fracture_v2.fbx and combat-assets.json
provenance.coordinateRule: Three=[Blender.x,Blender.z,-Blender.y]; parent centred mesh transform * (fragment local + offset_m)
provenance.ownershipRule: Original GLB manifest floor/cell, matching optimize-assets.py group_for
provenance.simplification: Coplanar dissolve 0.001 rad preserving material borders, then 0.25 collapse for meshes above 96 triangles; reject if components/materials lost, boundary edges increase or bounds shift >15 mm
provenance.palette: optimize-assets-v2.palette linear RGB quantized to normalized uint8
provenance.glass: All 287 source panes; eight original closed triangular prisms per pane, eight triangles each
provenance.sourceNonmanifoldSeams: Original architecture contains construction seams; no new boundary edges introduced
